Who we are 
 With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. 
 
 What we need   

 We are looking for a   3D Web Engineer   to join our   Simulation Team   within our   Software Engineering organization . Your job will be to design and develop cloud-based 3D digital twin and simulation applications that enable users to visualize, analyze, test, and interact with robotic warehouse automation systems. You will help build next-generation simulation platforms by combining modern frontend development, real-time 3D visualization, and digital twin technologies.    

   

 What we do   

 The   Simulation Team   is part of the   Software Engineering organization , which   is responsible for   building   the software   platforms and technologies that power   Symbotic's   warehouse automation solutions. Our team develops simulation systems, digital twin platforms, cloud applications, and visualization tools that help engineers, operators, and stakeholders better understand,   validate , and   optimize   robotic automation workflows.   

   

 What   you’ll   do   

 Design, develop, and   maintain   cloud-based 3D digital twin and simulation applications for robotic warehouse automation systems.    

 
 Build interactive 3D web applications using technologies such as Three.js, WebGL,   WebGPU , and related modern frontend technologies.    

 
 Develop frontend features that enable users to visualize robot movement, warehouse layouts, fleet behavior, simulation results, telemetry data, and system-level automation workflows.    

 
 Work on 3D rendering, scene management, camera controls, object interaction, animation, lighting, shadows, shaders, materials, and performance optimization.    

 
 Identify   and resolve frontend and 3D rendering performance bottlenecks to ensure smooth user experience across different platforms, browsers, and hardware configurations.    

 
 Integrate 3D visualization features with backend services, simulation engines, cloud APIs, telemetry streams, and digital twin data sources.    

 
 Collaborate with simulation engineers, robotics engineers, cloud engineers, backend engineers, UX/UI designers, product managers, and QA engineers to deliver cohesive and scalable simulation platform experiences.   

 
 Translate complex robotics, simulation, and operational requirements into intuitive and effective user-facing tools.   

 
 Provide senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with clear technical insights, trade-off analysis, risks, and recommendations to support long-term technical roadmaps.    

 
 Mentor other engineers, share technical knowledge, promote frontend and 3D engineering best practices, and help the team deliver innovative and scalable solutions.    

 
 Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, frontend design notes, API integration guides, and usage instructions.    

 

 Stay up to date with modern frontend development, 3D web graphics, cloud-based simulation, digital twin platforms, rendering engines, and AI-assisted development tools.    

 
 Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the direct manager or the Employer.   

 
   

   

   

 What   you’ll   need   

 Bachelor’s or   Master’s degree in Computer Science , Game Development, Computer Graphics, Robotics, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.    

 
 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience in front-end development and/or 3D application development.    

 
 Having experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Vue.js, Angular, or similar technologies is a plus.    

 
 Core Requirements:   

 
 Primary Stack:   Professional ReactJS and   ThreeJS   expertise   

 
 Language:   Mastery of JavaScript/TypeScript   

 
 Experience with 3D rendering techniques, including shaders, lighting, shadow mapping, materials, textures, camera systems, object   selection , and scene optimization.    

 
 Good understanding of frontend reliability, scalability, performance optimization, maintainability, and testing.    

 
 Plus: Experience with ECS software architecture pattern.   

 
 Plus: Experience with Blender   

 
 Plus: Experience with robotics systems, warehouse automation, digital twin platforms, simulation systems, telemetry visualization, or operational data platforms.    

 
 Plus: Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar tools.    

 
 Good teamwork, communication, time management, ownership, and problem-solving skills.    

 
 Working   proficiency   in verbal and written English, with the ability to communicate independently in an international environment and clearly present technical concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership stakeholders.   

 

   

 Our   E nvironment     

 Up to 10% of travel may be   required . Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.   

 
 Employees may   be required   to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued.   

 
   

 About   Symbotic   

 Symbotic   is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform.   Symbotic   reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density   storage   and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges,   Symbotic   enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility,   accuracy   and efficiency. As the backbone of   commerce   the   Symbotic   platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit   www.symbotic.com .   

     

 We are a community of innovators,   collaborators   and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees,   customers   and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world.   That’s   why   we’re   proud to be an equal opportunity employer.    

 We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information.
